metaTitle: Sheng Ji for Families: Consent, Privacy and Cost Checklist
metaDescription: Considering Sheng Ji for more than one family member? Review each person’s consent, privacy, total RMB cost, written delivery and the limits of family testimonials.
metaKeywords: family legacy feng shui,tycoon sheng ji,whole family sheng ji,succession fortune,elite family ritual
h1: Sheng Ji for families: consent and written terms come first
heroSub: A family purchase does not prove an effect · Protect each person’s choice and data

sections.h2: Treat each family member as a separate decision

items.content: Adults should decide for themselves after seeing the full service scope and cost. For minors, guardians should weigh privacy, safety and financial priorities; do not collect a child’s personal or biological materials without appropriate consent and safeguards.
Ask how names, birth details, recordings and personal materials will be stored, shared and deleted. Do not use another family member’s details as a marketing example without permission.

Published prices are RMB 72,000 per five-year service and RMB 500,000 per lifetime service. The booking deposit is RMB 10,000 per agreed booking; the balance and any later upgrade difference should be written down before payment.
Confirm each practitioner, plot arrangement, schedule, recording, returned items, rescheduling and refund rule. Do not assume one family member’s service covers another.

sections.h2: Do not use repeat purchases as proof

items.content: A family’s decision to buy again may reflect belief or preference. It does not establish that a ritual changed inheritance, health, relationships or future wealth.
